lardum.html: The preferred form: contracted from lāridum (Lewis & Short, which leaves the syncopated lardum unmarked); the libellī write lārdum (III, IV).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency: p. 70, checked against the searchable text of the book on 29 October 2026.

Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026, with their glosses. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word; classical passages are cited by author.
